features.description: spike: MCP App file-input widget in claude.ai
features.notes: claude.ai web (Firefox): widget at *.claudemcpcontent.com uploaded 14502 B docx via direct fetch POST (preflight+200) AND via host tools/call; same sha256 9081b7b0... both. connectDomains enforced. ui/message shows caution banner -> use ui/update-model-context. Desktop untested.

@mcp_ui_resource(uri, domains...) on () -> string: resources/list + resources/read, mimeType text/html;profile=mcp-app, _meta.ui.csp {connectDomains, resourceDomains: []} on both list entry and read content; "self" = request PublicBaseURL via an internal header the HTTP wrapper always overwrites (stripped from _headers); stdio read of a self widget errors. @mcp_ui -> _meta.ui.resourceUri + legacy _meta["ui/resourceUri"]; @mcp_app_only -> _meta.ui.visibility ["app"] (tool stays in tools/list, host hides it; callable). Load errors: unknown @mcp_ui URI, non-ui:// URI, bad origin, args/non-string resource fn, duplicate URI, @mcp_ui on resource fn. Resources capability was already always advertised. Golden testdata/mcp_ui.golden.json; 13/13 mutants killed; readyModule e2e unchanged. Pending: patch release.

@mcp_file -> _meta openai/fileParams + OpenAI file schema (inline, additionalProperties:false) on /mcp/ and /mcp/connect/; binds closed 4-string record (optional fields "", extras dropped; required unless @optional, which binds the all-empty record); bad name/type/secret = LoadModules error. Listed surface: securitySchemes top-level + _meta mirror (oauth2 | noauth). Refused gated call: HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate unchanged, body = JSON-RPC isError result with _meta mcp/www_authenticate [header]. mcp check --target openai: file-params + security-schemes. Tests: golden tools/list (testdata/mcp_file_tools_list.golden.json), bind e2e, refusal _meta, load errors, mcpcheck units; 15/15 mutants killed. Pending: patch release; V11 (does ChatGPT read the 401 body?) still needs a live ChatGPT test.
